name: push_twice_no_duplicates
description: Sync round trip. The same export asked twice must not duplicate cards -- _diff_task_and_card exists precisely for this. The second turn is the test; the first only sets the board up.

turns.message: Sube las tareas pendientes de Marketing Q3 a Trello y cuando termines dime cuantas subiste, cuantas ya estaban ahi y si alguna fallo
turns.why: First export. The user explicitly asks for counts, so the reply must carry real numbers.

turns.message: vuelve a subirlas por si acaso, no quiero que se me haya escapado ninguna
turns.why: THE POINT OF THIS CASE. Same request again. Nothing new should be created, and the reply must say they were already there instead of reporting a fresh export.
